I need support for

new_spinlock_irq!(try_pin_init!( Foo { }))

AFAICS we'd need to rework the base class sync::Lock for that so that it takes an impl PinInit<T, Error>.

Is there a reason why that's not already the case, would there be any major obstacles?
Just historical accident. No reason you can't add it.
I think I have a patch for this. Let me search.

I found the patch below. But also see this thread on a related discussion on pin_init_zeroed where @Benno Lossin suggest making the original function generic over the error type.

diff --git a/rust/kernel/sync/lock.rs b/rust/kernel/sync/lock.rs
index f390cd7ba0762..6025dd258ed35 100644
--- a/rust/kernel/sync/lock.rs
+++ b/rust/kernel/sync/lock.rs
@@ -8,6 +8,7 @@
 use super::LockClassKey;
 use crate::{
     str::{CStr, CStrExt as _},
+    try_pin_init,
     types::{NotThreadSafe, Opaque, ScopeGuard},
 };
 use core::{cell::UnsafeCell, marker::PhantomPinned, pin::Pin};
@@ -143,6 +144,22 @@ pub fn new(
             }),
         })
     }
+
+    pub fn try_new(
+        t: T,
+        name: &'static CStr,
+        key: Pin<&'static LockClassKey>,
+    ) -> impl PinInit<Self, kernel::error::Error> {
+        try_pin_init!(Self {
+            data: UnsafeCell::new(t),
+            _pin: PhantomPinned,
+            // SAFETY: `slot` is valid while the closure is called and both `name` and `key` have
+            // static lifetimes so they live indefinitely.
+            state <- Opaque::ffi_init(|slot| unsafe {
+                B::init(slot, name.as_char_ptr(), key.as_ptr())
+            }),
+        })
+    }
 }

 impl<B: Backend> Lock<(), B> {
diff --git a/rust/kernel/sync/lock/mutex.rs b/rust/kernel/sync/lock/mutex.rs
index 581cee7ab842a..f0fc062308983 100644
--- a/rust/kernel/sync/lock/mutex.rs
+++ b/rust/kernel/sync/lock/mutex.rs
@@ -17,6 +17,15 @@ macro_rules! new_mutex {
 }
 pub use new_mutex;

+#[macro_export]
+macro_rules! try_new_mutex {
+    ($inner:expr $(, $name:literal)? $(,)?) => {
+        $crate::sync::Mutex::try_new(
+            $inner, $crate::optional_name!($($name)?), $crate::static_lock_class!())
+    };
+}
+pub use try_new_mutex;
+
 /// A mutual exclusion primitive.
 ///
 /// Exposes the kernel's [`struct mutex`]. When multiple threads attempt to lock the same mutex,
diff --git a/rust/kernel/sync/lock/spinlock.rs b/rust/kernel/sync/lock/spinlock.rs
index d7be38ccbdc7d..faa5dd70b7c95 100644
--- a/rust/kernel/sync/lock/spinlock.rs
+++ b/rust/kernel/sync/lock/spinlock.rs
@@ -17,6 +17,15 @@ macro_rules! new_spinlock {
 }
 pub use new_spinlock;

+#[macro_export]
+macro_rules! try_new_spinlock {
+    ($inner:expr $(, $name:literal)? $(,)?) => {
+        $crate::sync::SpinLock::try_new(
+            $inner, $crate::optional_name!($($name)?), $crate::static_lock_class!())
+    };
+}
+pub use try_new_spinlock;
+

Why do you pass T here instead of impl PinInit<T, E>?
This should really just be change the existing new signature to propagate whatever error the impl PinInit<T> has.
